products.name: Eightfold AI
products.note: Talent intelligence platform; skills matching; DEI bias risk; high-stakes employment decisions

profile_text.body:
Eightfold is a talent intelligence company whose platform is aimed at HR leaders and focuses on recruiting, candidate screening, hiring, and workforce management. The company describes itself as "the agentic talent intelligence company" and positions its software as purpose-built for talent acquisition at scale, including high-volume hourly roles where a single position may attract hundreds of applicants. Its core product, the Eightfold AI platform, incorporates AI agents that conduct candidate interviews around the clock, summarize results for recruiters, and guide applicants through the process, while the company emphasizes that final hiring decisions rest with human recruiters rather than the AI.

Eightfold highlights two figures from customer results: some customers have reduced time-to-fill by 33 percent, and some have filled roles in as little as 1.3 days. The company also claims to operate under what it describes as "the world's first AI management standard," a certification it says is built, governed, and monitored against an independently audited framework. It states that its AI Interviewer product is tested for bias by independent auditors and that results are publicly available, framing responsible AI as externally verifiable rather than self-reported.

The site's held facts classify Eightfold AI under HR and talent AI, with noted applications including skills matching, DEI bias risk considerations, and high-stakes employment decisions. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company in the held data.
